The '''father''' of [[Nyranos]] was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who destroyed an [[Republic Kashyyyk embassy|embassy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] sometime well before the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Kaleesh was convicted of the crime and sentenced to life [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]; while imprisoned, they [[Parent/Legends|fathered]] a [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] named Nyranos. Although Nyranos was not guilty of any crime, [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Playt]] refused to grant parole to Nyranos or the descendants of any other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Master Jedi&mdash;my grandfather told me of your kind. I see now his stories were true.|Nyranos|<ref name="Riot">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Riot in the Warden's Station|Belsavis}}</ref>}}
Nyranos's father was mentioned in the Codex entry for the group known as the [[Condemned]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" /> Nyranos's dialogue in the game itself conflicts with the Codex entry; he speaks of talking with his grandfather,<ref name="Riot" /> but the Codex establishes that Nyranos was born after his father was imprisoned on Belsavis and that Nyranos had never left the planet by the time of the events of the game.<ref name="Codex" />
